tasks.issue: A command that displays usage with an empty options metavar acquires an extra space. Keep the separators correct when the optional usage fragment is empty.

A CLI option has an explicit empty-string default and is configured to display its default in help. The help text drops that default. Preserve the distinction between an empty default and an absent default.
An option with a choice type displays the wrong placeholder when the author disables showing its choices. The synopsis should respect that display option while preserving its accepted values.
A choice parameter in the command synopsis can be surrounded by two layers of brackets. Show it with the expected single level while keeping the optional-parameter notation.
Help and error hints do not display environment-variable names consistently for options with a sequence of names or an empty name. Keep the formatting correct in both cases.
Help paragraphs wrap early and leave unused space at the configured width. Format help text using the requested width while preserving indentation.
A documentation formatting marker appears verbatim in a command's short help. Produce a clean short summary from the original multiline help text.
A custom help option and a second eager option run in the wrong order. When help is given first, it should exit without triggering the later option's callback.
